run_get_chat_template: run the get_chat_template function to fetch a Jinja chat template from a HuggingFace model by model_id
run_get_chat_template_variant: run get_chat_template with a specific variant name to select a multi-variant chat template from a HuggingFace model
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point to fetch and print a chat template given a model_id and optional variant as command-line arguments
review_get_chat_template: review the get_chat_template function for handling both single and multiple chat template variants with fallback to default
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI function that parses model_id and optional variant arguments and outputs the fetched chat template
